what: Quantiles (5%, 25%, 75%, 95%) of book return over h daily bars divided by s_p = sqrt(sum_ij w_i u_i rho_ij w_j u_j), u_i = ATR14_i / close_i * sqrt(h), rho = correlation of the last 60 daily log returns. Displayed by pine/sl_portfolio_desk.pine.
calibrated_on: DEV + VAL, 2011-01-03 .. 2022-12-30, random books of 3 to 10 universe stocks sized as SL Risk Desk sizes them (research/experiments/g70_portfolio_band.py calibrate)
criterion_note: Fixed before the 2023-26 check: for risk-weighted books of 2, 3, 5, 8 and 10 positions, at each horizon, the 90% band holds 86-94% and the 50% band 45-55% of outcomes. Wider than the single-stock tolerance because the left tail of a diversified book depends on the regime (5% quantile at 10 bars: -1.15 on 2011-18, -1.43 on 2018-22).
